summary: SillyTavern format documents how its adapters detect, map, and round-trip Character Card V1 V2 and V3 cards plus standalone world info through the canonical model. Character JSON is the default export and PNG is available on request; V3 PNGs carry full V3 JSON in ccv3 and a V2-shaped chara backfill. One folder exports character, lorebook, regex, and persona codecs. Detection distinguishes character and lorebook paths; field mapping uses shared Tavern fields and lore enums. The original twin and sourceMedia support same-format field fidelity through a three-state overlay; JSON formatting and regenerated PNG chunks are not byte-identical promises. V3-only fields stay in ccv3 and the PNG backfill's extensions.vaudeville.escrow.fields; standalone V2 JSON has no CCv3-only slots. Other quirks include dual PNG chunks, talkativeness tolerance, world links by name, displayIndex, and regex and persona codecs. The folder also exports preset and prompt-format codecs: the preset codec reads KoboldAI, TextGen and NovelAI sampler sets, system prompts and reasoning templates besides chat-completion presets, and the prompt-format codec reads instruct and context templates.

sections.title: Detection
sections.summary: Detection follows registry highest score above 0.5 so more specific formats outrank generic ones. Character detect returns 0.9 for a recognizable card and 0 otherwise, not 1.0, because SillyTavern is the generic Tavern reader and RoleCall claims 1.0 on CCv3 with extensions.rolecall. Two recognition paths: PNG with chara V2 or ccv3 V3 text chunks scores 0.9 and non-card PNG falls through to JSON; JSON detectCard accepts chara_card_v3 or v2 with data, or flat objects with name plus a real character signal for V1 flat. Flat v1 is the cross-kind firewall so a worldbook name object never false-positives as a character. Lorebook returns 0.9 for native top-level entries object keyed by string index with entry-shaped values, 0.85 for portable character_book with entries array, and 0 otherwise so native wins any tie.

children.title: Character
children.summary: detect returns 0.9 for a recognizable card and 0 otherwise. Score is 0.9 not 1.0 so RoleCall on extensions.rolecall wins when present; plain CCv3 without that block is read by sillytavern. PNG path scores 0.9 when bytes carry chara V2 or ccv3 V3 text chunks; a non-card PNG falls through because real JSON reads carry both bytes and text. JSON detectCard recognizes chara_card_v3 with data, chara_card_v2 with data, or flat with name plus V1 core fields description personality scenario first_mes mes_example or V2-era alternate_greetings system_prompt post_history_instructions creator_notes extensions character_version. V2-era fields mark variant flat otherwise v1; worldbooks carry none so they never score positive.

children.title: Lorebook
children.summary: sillytavern-lorebook returns 0.9 for a native worldbook, 0.85 for a portable character_book, and 0 otherwise. Score 0.9 requires top-level entries as an object keyed by string index not an array, which would be RoleCall or Agnai, whose first value looks like an entry via key keysecondary comment or content. Score 0.85 is a Chub-style or card-extracted character_book object with an entries array, portable as ST but scored below native so the native file wins any tie.

sections.title: Field map
sections.summary: Field map covers Character shared Tavern data then Lorebook enums and entry wires. Character data mapping lives in tavern-fields dataToBody and applyBodyToData shared with Risu: identity name nickname description characterVersion, persona personality scenario, greetings first alternate group-only, examples mes_example, prompts system post_history depth_prompt, attribution creator notes source multilingual dates, discovery tags, settings talkativeness, worldName, assets to media, character_book via bundle knowledgeRefs, and PNG pixels in original.sillytavern.sourceMedia. depth_prompt talkativeness and world are first-classed from extensions; empty depth prompt maps to no injection. Lorebook uses lore-enums for selectiveLogic role position integers; entries map comment content disable keys order group match toggles vectorized automationId displayIndex; embedded character_book uses CCv3 dialect with ST extensions bag.

children.title: Character
children.summary: Shared Tavern data mapping covers data.name nickname description character_version to identity, personality scenario to persona, first_mes alternate_greetings group_only_greetings to greetings, mes_example system_prompt post_history_instructions, extensions.depth_prompt as origin depth_prompt, creator creator_notes source creator_notes_multilingual dates, tags, extensions.talkativeness with tolerant string or number, extensions.world as worldName not embedded book, assets to portrait and media, and character_book via bundle extract into knowledgeRefs not tavern-fields. PNG carrier pixels live in original.sillytavern.sourceMedia. Empty depth_prompt.prompt maps to no injection so depth and role ride the twin; role is carried only when authored. Resolved empty knowledgeRefs removes both primary character_book and legacy extensions.character_book so clearing a link cannot resurrect the twin book.

children.title: Lorebook
children.summary: ST world info encodes selectiveLogic role and position as integers via shared lore-enums: selectiveLogic 0-3 and_any through and_all, role 0-2 system user assistant, position 0-4 world character before_example after_example depth. Entry highlights map title from comment, content, enabled as not disable, triggers from key with inline regex decode, secondaryTriggers keysecondary, sortOrder from order, priority defaults 100 with no ST eviction axis, groupName group, scan match toggles including depth prompt and creator notes, vectorized groupOverride useGroupScoring automationId displayIndex. Embedded character_book uses CCv3 top-level keys secondary_keys insertion_order use_regex coarse before_char after_char with ST-extended fields in extensions, extensions winning when both present.

sections.title: Chats
sections.summary: Chats imports a SillyTavern chat .jsonl as a scene through the same import route as a card: inspect reads it, save-bundle or save-staged saves it into the ChatStore, and the Library drop sheet lists it. The codec returns a scene carrier of names, not a library entity, and is not in the adapter registry. Saving resolves the character by name and refuses the file, writing nothing, when the card is missing, ambiguous or already imported. mes is the shown text, swipes and swipe_id become the message swipes, times read in three shapes, and model, reasoning and generation time ride on each swipe. A user line matches its persona by avatar file, then by name. Hidden lines keep a hidden flag, chat variables become take variables, and group chats are refused whole.

sections.title: Escrow and round-trip
sections.summary: Escrow is the wrapper original Record keyed by format id; the character twin lives at original.sillytavern with the parsed card, unmapped variant v2 v3 v1 or flat, and sourceMedia b64 png only for PNG input. Same-format field fidelity comes from overlaying the body onto a clone of raw while preserving the original variant wrapper. Overlay is three-state against the twin decode via applyBodyToData: equal leaves parsed wire values untouched, changed writes, missing clears at the exact wire home; unknown keys and non-representable raw stay. Cross-format carries only the canonical body; raw extensions unknown keys and PNG stay in escrow uncopied. Lorebook collapses richer positions append append_bottom to depth 4, prepend_top to 0, scene to before_example 2; triggerMode always simple on read. Unedited entries re-project from raw twin by id preserving fields and raw-only carriers; JSON formatting may normalize. Raw-only uid vectors loreCache ride escrow untouched.

sections.title: Quirks
sections.summary: Quirks pin ST edges. V3-only fields stay in the full V3 envelope, and a V3 PNG's chara backfill escrows them under extensions.vaudeville.escrow.fields while ccv3 keeps the full card; media upgrades a non-V3 twin to V3. A V3 card writes both ccv3 and chara chunks, and the reader prefers ccv3.   World is by name, and displayIndex is never fabricated from sortOrder. The regex codec scores 0.9 for a bare array and 0.85 for a card block; the persona codec scores 0.95, imports the default persona and seals the whole backup; same-named personas get the avatar stem in the shown name only, and connections ride sealed. The preset codec also reads KoboldAI, TextGen and NovelAI sampler sets, system prompts and reasoning templates onto samplers, stock-ordered blocks and a reasoning field, sealing what Bunzai never sends, and an unedited import exports back to its file. The prompt-format codec reads instruct and context templates as one piece; a wrapper with a sysprompt stays a preset.

sections.title: Source of truth
sections.summary: Source of truth maps concerns to files. Character adapter detect toCanonical fromCanonical is formats sillytavern index.ts. World info codec is lorebook.ts; regex and persona codecs are sibling regex.ts and persona.ts. Shared Tavern field map is tavern-fields.ts; lore int-enum decoders are lore-enums.ts; embedded character_book mapper is character-book.ts; CCv3 assets to media is assets.ts; PNG chunk read write is png.ts. Coverage declaration is coverage.ts. Canonical wrapper escrow original and id policy live in core canonical.ts. Samples under samples sillytavern include CCv2 and v3 JSON plus Seraphina.png.
